title: Waffle Chart - How the World Is Powered

div.p: Each square is 1% of the electricity generated, coloured by source. Toggle the scenario and watch the squares recolour in place as the mix shifts, the fossil band shrinking while wind and solar grow.
div.div: chart.type: 'waffle' is an alias for the unit chart's grid layout with square cells; plotOptions.unit.grid.total: 100 rounds the values (largest remainder) to exactly 100 cells, so the grid always reads as percentages. Switching scenario is a plain chart.updateSeries(); the grid keeps every cell in its slot, so only the cells at each category boundary recolour. The unit / waffle chart is a premium type; without a license it renders with a trial watermark.
